title: Brain Dead x Invincible
collectionDescription: Our latest collection brings you the collaborative efforts of Brain Dead and the Taiwan-based streetwear brand, Invincible.
collectionDetails: The lineup begins with an assortment of Brain Dead x Invincible graphics in both t-shirt and crewneck form. Next up, we've got our Miller Chore Coat and Fishing Vest created with specially sourced, Italian-made technical nylon that's customized with a heat-treated adhesive process to create a wholly unique puckering pattern.
